row.title: Triage counted an optional Copilot assign as a failed run
row.body: With Issues on, scripts/triage.sh failed every run because the best-effort copilot-swe-agent assign went through the counting gh wrapper; safe_exit turned it red and skipped SLA, Scoreboard and orphan sync. Optional calls bypass the counter and log a note.

title: Triage counted an optional Copilot assign as a failed run
